corrections.reason: Both visually on the page and in standard Ge'ez orthography ('አርድእት', plural of 'ረድእ'), the character is 'እ' (Alf), not 'ዕ' (Ayn).
The printed glyph in the first word is 'እ' (Alf), forming the canonical Ge'ez demonstrative 'ወይእተ ዕለተ' (Luke 24:13), whereas the second word 'ዕለተ' has 'ዕ'.
On the physical page, Line 9 ends with 'እ' and Line 10 begins with 'ንተ' to form 'እንተ'.
Line 10 visually begins with 'ንተ' completing 'እንተ' from the end of Line 9.
The printed Ge'ez text clearly reads 'ከሃሌ' ('mighty/powerful', Luke 24:19 'ዘኮነ ከሃሌ በቃሉ ወበምግባሩ'), which was misread as 'ክሂሌ'.
The printed glyph has the 2nd-order (ka'ib) side stroke 'ቡ' ('ወረከቡ', masculine plural matching 'እለ ሖሩ' in Luke 24:24), not 4th-order 'ባ'.
The initial character is 1st-order 'ከ' (Amharic preposition 'ከ-' + 'ማመን', translating 'ለኢአሚን'), not 6th-order 'ክ'.
